Future<List<R>> mapBounded<T, R>(List<T> items, int limit, Future<R> Function(T item) read) async {
 final results = <R>[];
 final budget = currentBudget();
 final width = budget == null || limit < budget ? limit : budget;
 for (var start = 0; start < items.length; start += width) {
  final group = items.skip(start).take(width);
  results.addAll(await Future.wait(group.map((item) => budget == null ? read(item) : withBudget(budget, () => read(item)))));
 }
 return results;
}
